description: Tell your Switch Editor agent to build or revise the persistent editable project. It can author scenes, layers, variables, files, motion, and narration plans through the real HyperFrames project workspace. Pass workflow to run one of the eleven named editor workflows by id (proof-open, voice-narration, screen-record, real-tray-assets, prompt-breakdown-card, word-captions, beat-and-hits, hard-cut-pacing, credit-card, one-word-cta, long-form-retention-cut for a podcast or talking head into a finished vertical clip); the prompt then carries the creator's specifics and may be omitted to use the workflow's own sentence.

prompt.description: What to build or change, in plain words. Optional when workflow is set.

workflow.description: Optional named editor workflow to run; its recipe is added to the prompt.

name: run_editor_agent
title: Run Editor Agent
